title: Pathways toward operando recoverable CO2 electrolyzers
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,2492-2506
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07501G, Review Article
Xin Li, Jingyun Tian, Panpan Li, Huazhang Zhao, Bingjun Xu, Zishuai Zhang
This study redefines CO2 electrolyzer stability as a dynamic system property, identifies key failure modes, and outlines pathways toward operando recovery for industrial operation.
